assertions.name: quotient_correction_is_not_negligible
assertions.source: At the largest measured separation (alpha = 0.443227) the derived r^2 term is 14.46% of the kernel at the smallest corpus volume and 3.542% at the largest, against a noise floor of 2.656%. So the exact kernel is NOT indistinguishable from the one-term model on this data -- this is the first thing computing it would buy, and it grows with r, so it enters as a systematic trend.

assertions.name: correction_exceeds_coths_own_unresolvable_cubic
assertions.source: The quotient r^2 term reaches 14.46% where coth's own r^3/45 term reaches 0.138%, a ratio of 104.75. Recorded with a wide tolerance because the ORDERING is the content, not the value: the correction the corpus never modelled is larger than the one it already declared unresolvable.

assertions.name: fitter_selftest_refit_beats_frozen
assertions.source: Self-check on the optimiser, not on the physics: a refit over a superset of the frozen point must not do worse than the frozen point. The first version of this probe used a golden section on the scale alone and returned rms 25-32% where the true minimum is 2.7-3.0%, because the objective is not unimodal in the scale (coth diverges as it goes to 0). This assertion makes that class of failure loud.

assertions.name: the_correction_is_reabsorbed_by_the_exponent
assertions.source: The derived term is NOT small -- it reaches 14.46% of the kernel, 5.44x the noise floor, against only 0.138% for coth's own r^3/45 term which the corpus already calls unresolvable. Yet at MATCHED degrees of freedom every corpus volume lands within 15% of the uncorrected 2.755%: 2.7% to 2.718%, bought by an exponent shift of up to 0.0405. So the exact kernel would change the KERNEL materially and the FIT hardly at all -- the same kernel/exponent degeneracy the companion probe measures, one order down.

derivation.decomposition: G_M = G_dec + R on the ball of radius inj(M); both carry the same delta so Laplacian R = -1/vol(M) and R is smooth where G_dec is not.
derivation.exact_kernel_near_diagonal: kappa = coth r - c0 + (2 pi / (3 vol)) r^2 + O(r^3)
derivation.c0_identified: c0 = 1 + 4 pi R_0, the quotient's Robin constant. Round 6 scans c0 as a free modelling parameter; this identifies what it IS.
derivation.why_the_one_term_family_is_not_arbitrary: It is the exact quotient kernel truncated at O(r^2). The correction beyond it is parameter-free once vol is given.
derivation.condition: Valid for r < inj(M). A cusped quotient has arbitrarily small injectivity radius in the cusp and the corpus holds no per-isotope geometry to check this. Everything here is conditional on it.

coth_own_cubic_term_for_comparison.note: The corpus already reports this term as unresolvable (0.97% against 3.5% scatter). The quotient correction is compared against it.

scope.a_scope_limited: A statement about the SIZE of the leading quotient correction over the measured separations, at the volumes the corpus carries, conditional on those separations lying inside the injectivity radius. Not a computation of the exact kernel.
scope.what_is_new: That c0 is the Robin constant rather than a modelling parameter, that the one-term family is the exact kernel truncated at O(r^2), that the first neglected term is parameter-free -- so round 6's named next step is answerable in SIZE without summing a divergent series -- and that the term is nonetheless reabsorbed by the separation exponent, which is the degeneracy showing up one order down.
scope.NOT_claimed: That any corpus volume IS the fibre volume. That the exact kernel is excluded -- the test above uses one truncation at three assumed volumes, and a genuine quotient could differ in c0, in vol, and at O(r^3). That the metric Coulomb route fails: untouched.

q0AnchorReason: q0 enters only through upstream data: kappa(A) is read from em-linking-mirror-series.witness.json, whose producer divides by a TYPED per-pair Coulomb unit tanh(ln q0)*B_pp = 0.2376702253 with no recorded pin (the proton-pinned mirror-pair-coulomb-sign-correction witness it cites now carries 0.2212723003), and that upstream witness is itself unstamped; the pin of the series this probe fits is therefore undetermined
